oneOffs.name: Boise State Tailgate Parking Lot Event
oneOffs.who: Sports fans, local crowd, football-season regulars — all demographics, 21+
oneOffs.format: Daytime parking lot party kicking off football season. Beer tubs, food trucks, lawn games. Party moves inside after dark for the late-night set.
oneOffs.games: Cornhole, beer pong, giant Jenga, fantasy football draft board, jersey raffle
oneOffs.costuming: Jerseys, team gear encouraged — entertainers in team colors or cheerleader-style outfits

oneOffs.name: New Year's Eve Gala
oneOffs.who: Couples, groups, anyone looking for a premium NYE experience
oneOffs.format: Premium open bar packages, champagne toast at midnight, countdown celebration, special NYE menu. Higher cover, VIP tables available.
oneOffs.drinks: Champagne packages, Midnight Kiss (champagne + strawberry), Resolution cocktails
oneOffs.games: Countdown celebration, midnight kiss contest, resolution wall, photo booth
oneOffs.costuming: Formal/cocktail attire encouraged. Black tie optional VIP section.

oneOffs.name: Valentine's Special
oneOffs.who: Couples, singles, anyone looking for a romantic or anti-Valentine's night out
oneOffs.format: Couples packages, singles mingle games, romantic decor, red and pink theme. Special couples dances and VIP experiences.
oneOffs.drinks: Love Potion (pink cocktail), Broken Heart (whiskey + bitters), Cupid's Arrow (champagne + raspberry)
oneOffs.games: Singles mingle speed dating, couples dance contest, love song request hour
oneOffs.costuming: Red, pink, or black attire. Romantic or anti-romantic theme encouraged.

oneOffs.name: St. Patrick's Day Bash
oneOffs.who: Everyone — green beer and Irish whiskey draws all crowds
oneOffs.format: Full green decor, Irish whiskey specials, green beer, shamrock everything. DJ plays Irish rock remixes and party hits.
oneOffs.drinks: Green Beer, Irish Car Bombs, Jameson specials, Shamrock Shots
oneOffs.games: Best green outfit contest, Irish trivia, pot of gold raffle
oneOffs.costuming: Green mandatory. Leprechaun hats, shamrock accessories encouraged.

oneOffs.name: Blacklight Party
oneOffs.who: Everyone — high-energy crowd who loves neon, UV glow, and visual spectacle
oneOffs.format: Full club UV/blacklight transformation. Neon body paint station, glow sticks, white clothing encouraged. DJ plays high-energy EDM and hip-hop.
oneOffs.drinks: Glow-in-the-dark cocktails (tonic water base), Neon Margaritas, Blacklight Beer specials
oneOffs.games: Best glow outfit contest, neon body paint competition, glow stick dance-off
oneOffs.costuming: White or neon clothing required for full effect. Body paint available at entry.

oneOffs.name: Pole Competition
oneOffs.who: Entertainers, pole fitness community, fans of athletic performance art
oneOffs.format: Multi-round pole dancing competition with judges panel. Amateur and pro divisions. Audience voting + professional scoring.
oneOffs.drinks: Champagne specials, VIP bottle service for judges/sponsors, themed cocktails per round
oneOffs.games: Competition rounds (technical, artistic, freestyle), audience vote, judges' choice awards
oneOffs.costuming: Competition-appropriate athletic wear. Judges in formal attire.

series.name: Level Up
series.theme: College Night x Gaming x Cosplay
series.format: High-energy, exciting atmosphere.  Mario Kart periodically on the big screen --- entertainer vs customer
series.drinks: The Keg Stand (beer tower special), Jungle Juice (fruit punch + vodka), Body Shots (tequila + lime + salt), The Funnel (shared cocktail pitcher), Beach Bum (malibu + pineapple), Red Solo Cup (mixed drink in a giant cup), The Dorm Room (cheap beer bucket special)

series.name: Chicks 'n' Kicks
series.who: Sneakerhead Culture, Hypebeast Culture - People who have disposable income.
series.format: Sneaker culture night. Targeting Sneakerheadz and B-boys. Cross-promotion with local high-end sneaker stores.
series.drinks: Sneakertini, My Adidas, The Air Force One, etc
series.costuming: Entertainers wear dope sneakers with coordinating outfits. Fresh kicks front and center with fits that match the energy.
series.verbiage: Get ready to see our entertainers like never before! 🔥 Step into the weekend early with the launch of "Chicks 'n' Kicks" Thursdays. Our girls are pairing fresh sneakers with killer coordinating fits, bringing a whole new energy to the floor. The inaugural kickoff drops on September 24—and we’re keeping the vibe going every single Thursday night after that. Come for the dope kicks, stay for the show! 👟✨

series.name: Femme Fatale
series.format: High-end, glamorous night out. Showtime Showcase every Friday and Saturday at midnight. Featured Entertainer of the weekend takes the stage both nights for a carefully curated, high-production performance.
series.drinks: The Femme Fatale (dark rum + blackberry + gold leaf), Diamonds Are Forever (champagne + vodka + edible glitter), The Secret Agent (gin + cucumber + elderflower), Red Lipstick (red wine + bourbon + cherry), Silk & Dagger (sake + lychee + rose), The Executive (scotch + smoked orange peel + bitters)
series.games: Showtime Showcase at midnight — Entertainers introduced one by one, each takes a spin around the stage. Immediately following: Dance Special 2 for $40.

series.name: TORCHERED w/ANIMAL by Torch Radio
series.theme: AFTER DARK presented by Torch Radio
series.who: The after-hours crowd — people who want to keep the party going when everything else closes
series.format: After hours — we go until the early hours of the morning. Underground vibe. Guest DJs regularly. The only spot to BE after 2am in Boise on Saturdays — full kitchen serving breakfast items. Higher cover charge after 2am.
series.drinks: Cover charge ared the key profit driver for this night.
series.games: Showtime Showcase at midnight. Featured Entertainer performs a carefully curated, high-production set. After 2am — Late Night kicks in: guest DJs, full kitchen with Breakfast Specials.
